reels.caption:
Happy Earth Day, plant friends!🌏

To be human is to experience biophilia. Biophilia is the feeling of connection to the natural world and represents our innate desire to connect with nature and bond with other species.

Biophilia is becoming more relevant as people are raised within urban settings, and surrounded by technology rather than other living things. Plants are our natural partners in life and incorporating them into our lives could not only help us reconnect with the natural world, but also benefit our health and well being!

It is easy to take your interior or exterior design in a biophilic direction. We are in awe of how @fesi_djojo approached their home courtyard design which has evolved to have a garden in almost every room of the home 💚

#plantsmakepeoplehappy #biophilia #biophilicdesign #earthday #thesill
